question: Which state hosted the 6th edition of Khelo India Youth Games in 2024?
solution: The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **6th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games** was hosted by the state of **Tamil Nadu** in **2024**. • The Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) is an initiative launched by the **Government of India** to promote sports among youth and identify talent at the grassroots level. • KIYG is held annually in different states across India to foster sports culture and encourage young athletes. Tamil Nadu was selected as the host for the **2024 edition**. • **Chennai**, Tamil Nadu’s capital, was one of the key venues for the games, showcasing its infrastructure and organizational capacity. • The event included competitions across multiple sports disciplines, attracting participants from across the country.
